hotkey.hint: Press {{keys}} to bring up the quick panel
hotkey.pressKeys: Press a modifier and a key
hotkey.captureHint: Press the new combination, then save. Esc cancels; Tab moves to the buttons.

errors.reserved_hotkey: This combination is reserved for paste commands. Choose another shortcut.
errors.invalid_hotkey: Use a modifier and a non-modifier key. Your saved shortcut is unchanged. Press another combination.
errors.hotkey_busy: This shortcut could not be registered; it may already be in use. Your previous shortcut still works. Choose another combination.
errors.hotkey_storage: The shortcut could not be saved. Your previous shortcut still works. Check disk space and permissions, then retry.
errors.hotkey_cleanup: An extra shortcut registration could not be removed. Your clipboard history is unchanged. Restart OnePaste before changing shortcuts again.
errors.fallback: The saved shortcut could not be registered. The fallback shown above still works. Choose another combination or restore the default.
errors.hotkey_busyUnavailable: This shortcut could not be registered. No global shortcut is active. Choose another combination; Settings is also available from the tray.
errors.hotkey_storageUnavailable: The shortcut could not be saved. Your clipboard history is unchanged. Check disk space and permissions, then choose a shortcut again.
errors.fallbackUnavailable: Neither the saved shortcut nor the default could be registered. Your clipboard history is unchanged. Choose another combination; Settings is available from the tray.
errors.other: The shortcut change could not be confirmed. Your clipboard history is unchanged. Reopen Settings to check the active shortcut before retrying.

log.title: Event log
log.startup_repair_failed: Login startup registration could not be updated
log.settings_save_failed: Could not save the language setting
log.applied_remote: Put an item from another device on the clipboard
log.skipped_duplicate: Skipped: same as the last copy
log.apply_failed: Could not write to the clipboard
log.clipboard_monitor_failed: The clipboard monitor could not start
log.joined_with_recovery_kit: Joined the vault with the recovery kit
log.local_only_chosen: Chose to keep the history on this computer only
log.local_data_wiped: Cleared the data on this computer

webview2.missing: The Microsoft Edge WebView2 runtime was not found, so OnePaste cannot show its window. Please install it and then start OnePaste again.

paused.revoked: This device was removed from the vault, so syncing has stopped. Ask for a new connection code from another device and join again.
paused.server_rollback: The server shows older data than this device has already seen, so syncing has stopped. Use "onepaste resync" on the command line to recover.
paused.server_incompatible: This server speaks a different protocol version than this OnePaste. Upgrade the server, or update OnePaste. Your data is safe and nothing was lost.

queue.stuck: {{conflict}} changes are in conflict and {{failed}} could not be uploaded.

search.placeholder: Search your history (local index, never uploaded)

results.empty: Nothing yet. Copy some text or an image and it will appear here.
results.error: The history could not be read ({{code}}). Your data is safe on this computer. Try again in a moment, or restart OnePaste.

settings.title: Settings
settings.autoApply: Put what you copy on your other devices into this computer's clipboard
settings.record: Record what I copy on this computer
settings.privacyBody: Clipboard content never goes into logs or diagnostics. Diagnostics only list event kinds, sizes and error codes.
settings.aboutBody: All your data is encrypted from end to end. OnePaste sends no telemetry.

detail.title: Details
detail.none: Select an item to see its details.

devices.soonHint: Renaming a device needs a change on the server and is not available yet.
devices.removeBody: Remove "{{name}}" from your vault? It stops syncing right away and will no longer receive your history. Items it already has stay on that computer. To add it again you need a new connection code.
devices.addBody: Make a connection code, then open OnePaste on the other computer and choose "Connect to my own server".
devices.addReminder: On the second desktop, choose Connect to my own server, paste this new code, click Next and enter your original passphrase to Join. This code is single-use; do not share it publicly. Generating another code invalidates earlier unused codes. Keep your recovery kit safe in case you forget the passphrase.
devices.localTitle: This computer keeps its history to itself
devices.localBody: Nothing is synced, so there are no other devices. To use more than one computer, set OnePaste up again and connect it to your own server.

errors.cannot_revoke_this_device: This device cannot remove itself here.

mode.title: How do you want to use OnePaste?
mode.localHint: Keep a searchable history of what you copy here. Nothing is synced.
mode.serverHint: Sync your history between your computers through a server you run.

code.title: Connect to your server
code.intro: Enter the connection code your server gave you.
code.serverHelp: Run the server on the Docker machine and use the desktop app on your computers.
code.helpError: Could not open the browser. Try again; your entries are still here.

steps.code: Get the complete onepaste1: connection code from the server, paste it here, then click Next. The server address is not an administration webpage.
steps.first: First computer on an empty server: choose and confirm a passphrase → Next → save the recovery kit offline → check the saved confirmation → Done.
steps.existing: If a vault already exists, enter its original passphrase to Join. If you forgot it, choose “I forgot my passphrase, I have a recovery kit”.
steps.second: For a second computer, get a fresh code from the connected desktop: Devices → Add a device → Make a connection code. On the second desktop, choose Connect to my own server, paste the new code and join with the same passphrase.

unlock.title: This server already has a vault
unlock.intro: Type the passphrase of your vault to add this computer. The passphrase is used once and never saved.
unlock.forgot: I forgot my passphrase, I have a recovery kit

kitJoin.title: Join with a recovery kit
kitJoin.intro: Paste the recovery kit you saved when the vault was created.
kitJoin.label: Recovery kit

passphraseStep.title: Choose a passphrase
passphraseStep.intro: This server has no vault yet, so a new one will be created. Choose a passphrase you will remember. You will need it to add your other computers.

kit.title: Your recovery kit
kit.warning: This string is your key. If you forget your passphrase and lose it, your data cannot be recovered.
kit.copied: Copied. Paste it somewhere safe, then clear your clipboard.
kit.saved: I have saved it somewhere offline

errors.wrong_passphrase: The passphrase is wrong. Nothing was changed.
errors.wrong_recovery_kit: This recovery kit is not valid for this vault. Check that it was copied completely.
errors.vault_exists: This server already has a vault. Go back and join it instead.
errors.invalid_connection_code: This is not a valid connection code.
errors.unreachable: The server cannot be reached. Check the address and your network.
errors.registration_invalid: The connection code has expired or was already used. Get a new one from the server and start again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.already_set_up: OnePaste is already set up on this computer.
errors.no_pending_setup: The setup was interrupted. Start again.
errors.unsupported_version: The server speaks a different protocol version than this OnePaste. Upgrade the server or update OnePaste.

security.title: Security and privacy
security.showKitWarning: Anyone who sees the recovery kit can read your data. Make sure no one is looking at your screen.
security.wipeWarning: This deletes the history and the key on this computer and returns OnePaste to its first start. Your server and your other computers are not changed.
security.wipeWarningLocal: This deletes the whole history and the key on this computer. It cannot be undone.

qp.pastePermission: Enable Accessibility for OnePaste in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility. Without it, this shortcut only copies and closes.
qp.manualPaste: Copied. Could not finish restoring the previous app and sending the paste keys. Check the destination before pasting manually.
qp.copyFailed: Could not finish copying and closing. Try again, or press Escape to close the panel.
qp.settingsFailed: Could not open Accessibility Settings. Open System Settings, then Privacy & Security → Accessibility. Add OnePaste there.
qp.title: Quick panel
qp.error: The search did not work ({{code}}). Your data is safe. Press Esc and try again.

settingsMore.trayNote: Closing the window keeps OnePaste running in the tray. Quit from the tray menu.
settingsMore.skipSecrets: Do not record things that look like keys or tokens
settingsMore.skipSecretsHint: Only new text copied on this computer. May skip ordinary text or miss secrets.
settingsMore.skipSecretsRules: Private-key start markers: PRIVATE KEY, ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY, RSA PRIVATE KEY, DSA PRIVATE KEY, EC PRIVATE KEY and OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY. GitHub token prefixes: ghp_, github_pat_, gho_, ghu_, ghs_ and ghr_. These are offline heuristics, not proof that a key or token is real.
settingsMore.skipSecretsBoundary: Turning this off still respects system sensitive markers. Existing history, remote items and command line or API writes are not scanned.
settingsMore.saveFailed: Could not save this setting. Try again.
settingsMore.respectMarker: Respect the system's "exclude from history" marker
settingsMore.excludedApps: Apps whose copies are never recorded
settingsMore.sizeLimitHint: Applies to future copies of text and images, including encoding and envelope overhead. Existing history is kept.
settingsMore.sizeLimitNotice: This copy exceeded the item size limit and was not saved or synced. Copy a smaller item, or increase the limit in Settings. Your existing history is unchanged.
settingsMore.hotkeyHint: Saved changes take effect immediately. If registration fails, an existing working shortcut is kept.

updates.title: Updates
updates.autoHint: Once when OnePaste starts and then every six hours. Nothing but the version of this program is sent.

channelHint.preview: Includes the automatic pre-releases made after every change. They are the newest and the roughest.
channelHint.beta: Beta releases that a person made and named. No automatic pre-releases.
channelHint.stable: Only releases that are not pre-releases. There is none yet.

errors.update_no_key: This build is not set up to check for updates.
errors.update_unreachable: The update server cannot be reached. Try again later.
errors.update_status: The update server did not answer as expected. Try again later.
errors.update_damaged: The update information is damaged. It was not used.
errors.update_bad_signature: The update information is not signed correctly, so it was not used.

closeNotice.title: OnePaste keeps running
closeNotice.body: Closing the window does not quit OnePaste. It keeps running in the tray (the menu bar on a Mac) so that it can record what you copy. Click its icon to open the window again, and choose Quit to close it completely.

image.failed: The picture could not be shown.
image.saveFailed: The picture could not be saved. Check the place you chose and try again.

changeServer.title: Change server
changeServer.intro: Reconnect this computer using a fresh connection code from the new server.
changeServer.codeHint: Paste the complete new onepaste1: connection code.
changeServer.existing: The new server already has a vault.
changeServer.emptyDetails: The current vault key and recovery kit will be kept. Existing items will be uploaded to the new server.
changeServer.existingDetails: Enter its passphrase or recovery kit. The vault must use the same master key as this computer.
changeServer.keepHistory: Your local history and vault key will be kept.
changeServer.oldDevice: This computer's device record will remain on the old server.
changeServer.otherDevices: Other devices must each reconnect using a fresh code from the new server.
changeServer.confirmHint: The connection changes only after you confirm. A different vault or failed check leaves your current connection unchanged.
changeServer.doneBody: This computer is now connected to the new server. Local history has been kept.

errors.unreachable: The new server could not be reached. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Check the new code and network, then try again.
errors.invalid_connection_code: The connection code is not valid. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Paste the complete new code and try again.
errors.registration_invalid: The connection code has expired or was already used. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Get a fresh code and try again.
errors.wrong_passphrase: The passphrase did not unlock that vault. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Go back and correct the passphrase, or use the recovery kit.
errors.wrong_recovery_kit: The recovery kit did not unlock that vault. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Go back and use its correct kit or passphrase.
errors.wrong_key: That server holds a different vault. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Use a fresh code for the same vault or an empty server.
errors.passphrase_required: That server now has a vault and needs its passphrase or recovery kit. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Go back and check the code again.
errors.rate_limited: The new server is limiting requests. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Wait a moment, then try again with a fresh code.
errors.unsupported_version: The new server uses an incompatible protocol version. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Update the app or server, then try again.
errors.storage: The new connection could not be saved locally. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Check available disk space and permissions, then retry with a fresh code.
errors.not_joined: This computer is no longer connected to a server. Your history was not changed by this attempt. Close this dialog and check its setup.
errors.other: The server change could not be confirmed. Your local history is kept. Close this dialog and reopen Settings to check the saved server address before retrying.
errors.server_change_failed: The server could not be changed. Your local history and current connection are unchanged. Check the new code and try again.

startup.hint: Starts hidden in the tray or menu bar when you sign in. Moving the portable folder updates the registration the next time you open OnePaste.
startup.unstable: Move OnePaste to a permanent folder with a shorter path and reopen it before enabling login startup. Temporary download locations or very long paths cannot be registered.
startup.failed: Could not update login startup or read its system registration. Try again after reopening OnePaste.
